why: Every theorem of A, theorem_6_37 included, assumes PX.AdmitsBumpFunctions, a TAME sc-Fredholm section (IsScFredholmSectionTame), HasScPlusSectionsThrough (from the bumps) and two more paracompactness instance families. B gives none of these; they are satisfiable but not consequences of B. With them added, A_to_BExtra is proved. Existence: Gamma_f on representatives is a functor in B's sense; every admissible beta-composite is homotopic rel end points to concatPath; A's (*), on all open propagation sets, gives B's (*), which is asked only on contractible ones. Uniqueness: proved only under ContractibleCover (every smooth point lies in an open, sc-smoothly contractible propagation set), via orFunctorMap_unique_of_cover. Without that cover, B's (*) constrains G only on paths inside the contractible propagation sets that exist; a functor twisted by the swap of Or_x^f at a point in no such set satisfies B's (*) too, and the project never constructs such sets. B => A fails: A states facts about the project's constructions (orPush, orLocalTransport, orFunctorMap, (*) on all open propagation sets, cover-form uniqueness).
overlap: A_to_BExtra: 4276 shared project theorems (sc-calculus, Fredholm and determinant glue, Chapter 6 propagation machinery); the item's theorems are used only through the hypothesis hA. #rt_check_soft is OK with review: orPush_eq, orPush_compat and orPush_trans are reached only through the proof fields of orFunctorMap and orLocalTransport, which A_to_BExtra mentions.
